name: Rhea Dradie Simons
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
Obituary of Elaine Upham, Tri-City Herald, 14 Aug 2011 (transcribed on Find a Grave, memorial 75368477)
notes: First child of Ray and Dradie (Kulp) Simons; born and died on 19 Sep 1916 at Milton (Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree). She is the second sister who, with Beryl, predeceased Elaine, according to Elaine's 2011 obituary.
